description: This Java class, ShoppingCartServiceImpl, implements shopping cart functionalities such as retrieving, saving, updating, deleting, and merging shopping carts. It interacts with DAOs, services, and models related to products, customers, and shipping within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ShoppingCartServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ShoppingCartService interface providing core methods to manage shopping carts, including retrieval, population, merging, and deletion.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart for a customer and populates its contents, removing it if obsolete.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a shopping cart based on its ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a shopping cart by its ID and store, populates it, removes if obsolete.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a shopping cart by code and store, populates it, removes if obsolete.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart for a specific customer.

methods.name: populateShoppingCart
methods.description: Populates a shopping cart's items with current product info and prices.

methods.name: populateShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Creates a ShoppingCartItem from a product, setting price and attributes.

methods.name: createShippingProduct
methods.description: Creates a list of shipping products from cart items that require shipping.

methods.name: isFreeShoppingCart
methods.description: Determines if the shopping cart contains only free items.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Checks if the cart contains items that require shipping.

methods.name: mergeShoppingCarts
methods.description: Merges a session cart into a user cart, combining items appropriately.
